title: Outputs for alternating-word types
statement: Fix natural numbers $C_w$ and $c_w$. For a type in $\{\mathrm{ac},\mathrm{an},\mathrm{a0},\mathrm{a1},\mathrm{aj},\mathrm{aj1}\}$ and a Boolean word $z$, define its output word as follows: for $\mathrm{ac}$ use the parsed second component of the outer second projection of $z$; for $\mathrm{an}$ use its fixed-width binary successor, taking the empty word on overflow; for $\mathrm{a0}$ use the all-zero word of length $C_w(|x|+1)^{c_w}$, where $x$ is the first component of the first projection of $z$; for $\mathrm{a1}$ use the successor of that all-zero word, again taking the empty word on overflow. For $\mathrm{aj}$ use the concatenation of the binary representation of the length of the parsed first component of the outer second projection and an all-zero word whose length is the parsed second component's length; for $\mathrm{aj1}$ use its fixed-width successor, taking the empty word on overflow. Every parsed component here is obtained by the total projections, which return the empty word when parsing fails.
hypotheses_covered: input type is one of the six constructors of $AW$
